title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“这.......这到底是什么东西啊？”王大年等黑风寨的弟兄们全部惊呼出声。杨成没有直接回答。而是从地上捡起了一把，直接扔给了王大年。让王大年仔细观摩。眼前的这个黑洞洞的玩意，王大年还是第一次见。光看外形的话，王大年第一印象里会认为这是一把枪。可是枪又怎么会是这个样子的呢？“大当家的，这到底是什么东西啊？”王大年再一次忍不住好奇地问道。“95式自动步枪，全长746毫米，全重3.25公斤，口径5.8毫米，战斗射速单发40发每分钟，连发100发每分钟，弹匣容量30发，有效射程400米。”听到王大年的询问，杨成也没有藏着掖着。将当初在军校以及部队当中，了解到的有关95式自动步枪的所有参数全部讲解了一遍。“95式？”“自动？”听到杨成话语当中的那些专业术语，王大年整个人都被整迷糊了。显然，杨成说的话，他一个也听不懂。不过从杨成的话语里，王大年大致能明白。眼前的这个黑洞洞的家伙，是一把枪。而且好像还是一把性能十分出众的枪械。不过王大年觉得这枪长得也太奇怪了，和自己常使的三八大盖长得完全不一样。长度也就只有三八大盖的一半，重量却比三八大盖轻不了不少。不过这玩意的做工，还真是精细啊。王大年也不知道自己的大当家是从哪里搞来的这批东西。也对这些枪支的威力产生了质疑。不过杨成也懒得解释什么，倭军还有不久就要来了。这些东西只能以后再讲给他们听了。只见杨成没有啰嗦，直接从地上捡起了一把95式自动步枪。将95式自动步枪架在了自己的右肩。快速的装弹，上膛，拨动保险，瞄准，射击。只见枪口处冒出火焰。一连串的子弹被射了出去，在墙上留下了一个个深不见底的弹坑。无需任何多言，杨成的操作，直接将所有人给看傻眼了。此时的王大年等人，惊讶地嘴巴都能塞进一颗鸡蛋了。只见王大年屁颠屁颠地跑到了不远处的墙体，仔细地观摩起了墙体上的弹坑。

光是从弹坑的深度来看，这威力绝对比三八大盖要强得多。更令人震撼的是，刚才杨成的动作前后不到五秒。这惊人的子弹装填速度，以及惊人的射速。让人一阵心惊。“这......这是枪？”“这也太恐怖了吧。”“这么小巧的枪支，还没三八大盖一半大呢，威力竟然这么大。”所有黑风寨的弟兄们不由得一阵惊呼。纷纷开始议论起来。“先不说这威力，这东西的射速才恐怖呢。”“前不久，我撞见过小鬼子和其他队伍作战，他们的机枪射速也不过如此啊。”“而且，他们的机枪压根就不能像这东西一样，可以放在肩上射击。”“这简直就是小型的机枪啊。”有人不禁感叹道。“小型机枪？”...听见众人的议论，杨成笑了。“那你们见识过，不用冷却降温，不用在子弹上涂油防止卡壳，而且可以单兵操作的机枪吗？”杨成一改严肃的模样笑着说道。听到杨成的话，众人这才吃惊道。“是啊，我看鬼子们的机枪，每打掉一个弹夹，就要冷却降温。”“可是这玩意，压根就不用啊。”“这简直太恐怖了。”看着手底下弟兄一个个像刘姥姥进大观园的模样，杨成也没有再多说什么了。“我来不及和你们解释了，刚刚的操作你们可能没有看清。”“一会每人挑选一把，我来教你们怎么使用。”“你们当中的每一个人，都必须要在半个小时之内，将这款步枪给练熟。”“今天，咱们高低得让来犯我黑虎山的小鬼子们喝上一壶。”“每个人在学会之后，都得拿这些枪给我狠狠地打这些鬼子。”“不然以后你们出去，别说是我手底下的人。”杨成对着众人下达了死命令。“是，大当家的。”听到杨成的话，众人简直欣喜若狂。怪不得之前大当家的说那些三八大盖是垃圾。有了这玩意，谁还会正眼看那些三八大盖？今天必须得把这些鬼子打得找不着北才行。

"What the hell is this?" Wang Danian and other brothers in Heifeng Village all exclaimed.Yang Cheng did not answer directly.Instead, he picked up a handful from the ground and threw it directly to Wang Danian.Let Wang Danian observe carefully.This was the first time Wang Danian had seen this dark thing in front of him.Just looking at the appearance, Wang Danian's first impression would be that it was a gun.But why does the gun look like this?"Master, what on earth is this?" Wang Danian couldn't help but asked curiously again."Type 95 automatic rifle, with a total length of 746 mm, a total weight of 3.25 kg, a caliber of 5.8 mm, a combat rate of fire of 40 rounds per minute, a burst of 100 rounds per minute, a magazine capacity of 30 rounds, and an effective range of 400 meters." After hearing Wang Danian's inquiry, Yang Cheng did not hide it.I explained all the parameters about the Type 95 automatic rifle that I learned in the military academy and the army."Type 95?" "Automatic?" Wang Danian was completely confused when he heard the professional terms in Yang Cheng's words.Obviously, he didn't understand anything Yang Cheng said.But from Yang Cheng's words, Wang Danian could roughly understand.The dark guy in front of me is a gun.And it seems to be a firearm with outstanding performance.However, Wang Danian felt that this gun looked too strange, and it looked completely different from the Sanba Gai he often used.The length is only half of the 38-meter lid, but the weight is not much lighter than the 38-meter lid.But the workmanship of this thing is really exquisite.Wang Danian didn't know where his boss got these things from.Questions have also been raised about the power of these guns.However, Yang Cheng was too lazy to explain anything. The Japanese army was coming soon.These things can only be told to them later.Yang Cheng didn't hesitate and just picked up a Type 95 automatic rifle from the ground.He placed the Type 95 automatic rifle on his right shoulder.Quickly reload, load the gun, flip the safety, aim, and shoot.Only flames were seen coming from the muzzle of the gun.A series of bullets were fired, leaving bottomless craters in the wall.Needless to say, Yang Cheng's operation stunned everyone.At this time, Wang Danian and others were so surprised that they could stuff an egg into their mouths.I saw Wang Danian running to the wall not far away and carefully observing the craters on the wall.

Judging from the depth of the crater alone, this power is definitely much stronger than the 38-meter Gai.What's even more shocking is that Yang Cheng's actions just now took less than five seconds.This amazing bullet reloading speed, as well as amazing firing rate.It's shocking."This...is this a gun?" "This is too scary." "Such a small gun, less than half the size of a 38-year-old gun, is so powerful." All the brothers in Black Wind Village couldn't help but exclaimed.Everyone started talking."Let's not talk about the power, but the rate of fire of this thing is terrifying." "Not long ago, I saw the Japs fighting with other teams, and their machine guns only had this rate of fire." "Moreover, their machine guns can't be put on the shoulders to shoot like this thing." "This is simply a small machine gun." Some people couldn't help but sigh."Small machine gun?"... Hearing everyone's discussion, Yang Cheng smiled."Then have you ever seen a machine gun that does not need to be cooled down, does not need to be oiled on the bullet to prevent jamming, and can be operated by a single soldier?" Yang Cheng changed his serious look and said with a smile.After hearing Yang Cheng's words, everyone was surprised."Yes, I see that the Japs' machine guns need to be cooled down every time a magazine is knocked out." "But this thing is not used at all." "This is simply too scary." Looking at his brothers who looked like Grandma Liu entering the Grand View Garden, Yang Cheng said nothing more."I don't have time to explain to you. You may not have seen the operation just now." "Everyone will choose one later, and I will teach you how to use it." "Everyone of you must master this rifle within half an hour." "Today,We must give the little devils who come to my Black Tiger Mountain a drink."After everyone learns, you must use these guns to beat these devils hard.""Otherwise, when you go out, let alone my subordinates," Yang Cheng gave the order to everyone."Yes, the boss." After hearing Yang Cheng's words, everyone was overjoyed.No wonder the boss said those 38-year-olds were rubbish.With this thing, who would look at those 38 big covers?Today we must defeat these devils until they are unable to find their way to the north.
